snippet.title: Brotherhood - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2635450/Brotherhood/

An old-school shooter inspired by Wolfenstein 3D. You are one of the prisoners of an ancient prison. There is no one to help you. You only have yourself to rely on. Your shotgun. Against hordes of enemies. Animal rage and the desire to kill. Destroy Them All!
